title: The Double portion of rice
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：double　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 double 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the observer wrote of ① a double portion of rice in the log, and everybody in the observatory said at once that it was ② so double that nobody in the observatory would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the observer, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the double ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the double portion of rice that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log for November 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too double to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the double ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a double reason for the rule, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as double as the reason for the rule they had once had in the old observatory. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was double or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something double, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next observatory called the whole plan ⑧ quite double; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the double ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, with great care, she wrote of another double portion of rice in the same log, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less double than anybody had expected. ⑩ The double reason for the rule that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the double ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 双倍（前置定语 a double portion of rice：1957 年观测员在观测记录里记下的那件双倍的米饭）
B. adj. 双倍／双重（两处加强说法：so double that … 与 no less double than …）
C. adj. 双倍／双重（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 双倍（表语 too double to do：母亲觉得它太双倍，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 双重（前置定语 a double reason for the rule：叔叔把整件事称作一桩双重的缘由）
F. adj. 双重（同级比较 as double as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那条规矩的双重缘由相比）
G. adj. 双重（后置定语 something double：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 双重（受程度副词修饰 quite double：那位助手的评价）

items.q: the double portion of rice that
a double reason for the rule
The double reason for the rule that

answers.why: double 意为“双倍”，1957 年观测员在观测记录里记下的是“一件双倍的米饭”，此处作前置定语 a double portion of rice。
double 意为“双倍”，此处用 so double that 结构，说它双倍到观测站里没人敢靠近。
double 意为“双倍”，观测记录上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的双倍双份的米饭，等于最高级的说法。
double 意为“双倍”，母亲认为这件东西“太双倍了，谁也用不上”，too double to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
double 意为“双重”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩双重的缘由”，此处作前置定语 a double reason for the rule。
double 意为“双重”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那条规矩的双重缘由一样双重”，同级比较用 as double as。
double 意为“双重”，观测记录上那半行字要的是“双重的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something double。
double 意为“双重”，邻观测站来的那位助手认为这套计划“相当双重”，quite 修饰原级 double。
double 意为“双重”，no less double than 表示“其双重不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之双重不亚于任何人的预料。
double 意为“双重”，母亲 1969 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的双重缘由”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，观测员在观测记录里记下了一件双倍的米饭。（a double portion of rice）
它双倍到观测站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so double that …）
母亲觉得它太双倍，谁也用不上。（too double to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩双重的缘由。（a double reason for the rule）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那条规矩的双重缘由一样双重。（as double as …）
到了 1964 年，观测记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件双重的东西。（something double）
answers: In 1957 the observer wrote of a double portion of rice in the log.
It was so double that nobody in the observatory would go near it.
My mother thought it too double to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a double reason for the rule.
He said nobody would call it as double as the reason for the rule they had once had.
By 1964 the log asked for nothing but something double.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 double 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the observer wrote of a double portion of rice in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the double portion of rice that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too double to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a double reason for the rule, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next observatory called the plan quite double, and everybody laughed.
The double ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
